doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

grok.positioning: xAI's general assistant with real-time search and native tool use, on web and mobile, where news breaks first (verified: x.ai, docs.x.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
grok.quirk: a pigeon on the bench freezes mid-head-bob when the street freezes, one foot still lifted
grok.narration: The whole street changes its mind three times before your coffee cools. Grok is the assistant that watches the world in real time, from the place where news breaks first. Ask it while it's still happening.
grok.closer: Grok, real-time answers with the sources still warm. Ask it while it's happening. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
grok.look_prompt: She sits centred at a small rooftop cafe table at night, square to the camera, city lights bokeh rising evenly on both sides behind her, warm string lights above. She wears a charcoal bomber jacket over a white tee, hair loose, minimal natural makeup, calm confident half-smile. A closed laptop and a small coffee cup rest on the table in front of her. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: A city bus stop at dusk where every screen, newspaper and billboard on the street flips its headline in unison, then flips again, faster and faster, pages molting off a newsstand like feathers while one man sits still watching. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: The same street frozen absolutely still mid-flip, one newspaper page hanging in the air, a pigeon on the bench paused mid-head-bob with one foot lifted, while the man alone moves, standing up slowly and looking around. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: The man walks calmly through the frozen street at dusk, weaving between suspended pages, and sits back down as the street gently resumes at half speed around him. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

zai.positioning: Zhipu's open frontier GLM models for builders, high-end coding and reasoning at cost-efficient prices (verified: z.ai, docs.z.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
zai.quirk: the coffee mug never moves an inch through the whole expansion, steamless and steady
zai.bed: warm minimal tech pulse with soft piano, instrumental
zai.narration: Her studio apartment is smaller than the problem she's solving. Z.ai puts frontier open models in anyone's hands, the same weights the big labs guard, priced for builders. Build like the room was never small.
zai.closer: Z.ai, frontier open models priced for builders. Start building tonight. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
zai.look_prompt: She sits at a minimal light-wood desk in a small bright studio apartment, facing the camera at a slight angle, wearing a relaxed sage-green shirt over a white top, hair in a low ponytail, minimal natural makeup, focused warm expression. A closed silver laptop and a ceramic mug sit at rest on the desk, morning light from a side window, a small plant on a shelf behind. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: A tiny studio apartment where a student sits at a small desk, and the room begins to EXPAND, walls sliding back, her one desk stretching into a long row of glowing workstations filling a warehouse-sized space around her while she keeps typing. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: The vast warehouse of workstations hums around the student, screens scrolling, and on her original desk a ceramic coffee mug sits perfectly still, unmoved, while everything grows around it. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: The warehouse folds back in on itself smoothly, walls returning, screens tucking away, until it is the tiny studio apartment again, the student stretching, the mug exactly where it always was. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

moonshot.positioning: Moonshot's Kimi K3, million-token context and agent swarms for long-horizon coding and knowledge work (verified: moonshot.ai, kimi.com, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
moonshot.quirk: one red bookmark ribbon stays hanging out of the closed mail slot
moonshot.bed: hushed library strings turning bright, instrumental
moonshot.narration: She has one question and a library's worth of everything else. Kimi reads the whole million pages in a breath and hands back the one line that matters. Ask it something enormous.
moonshot.closer: Kimi, the assistant that reads everything and answers with one line. Ask it something enormous. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
moonshot.look_prompt: She sits centred in a cosy reading nook, matching tall bookshelves rising symmetrically on both sides behind her, warm lamp glow from each side, facing the camera square-on, wearing a soft camel sweater, hair down in loose waves, minimal natural makeup, gentle knowing smile. A single closed book rests on the cushion beside her. Evening light, deep warm tones. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: A quiet hallway with a small wooden door that has a brass mail slot. A woman posts a single folded note into the slot, and the corridor behind her ROARS as an entire library's worth of loose pages streams past her INTO the slot in one long breath, shelves emptying. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: The last pages whip into the brass mail slot and the little door shudders shut, leaving the corridor empty and clean, one red bookmark ribbon left hanging out of the slot, swaying. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: The slot opens gently and a single small card slides out into the woman's open hand. She reads it, nods once, and walks away down the empty corridor. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

claude.positioning: Anthropic's Claude, the AI for problem solvers, a thoughtful collaborator for serious work (verified: claude.com, anthropic.com, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
claude.quirk: one of the duplicate selves has folded his notes into a paper crane and set it down
claude.bed: steady thoughtful piano over low warm synth, instrumental
claude.narration: Forty versions of you are arguing around the table and every one of them is sure. Claude is the collaborator that thinks it through with you, carefully, until the answer is one page. Bring it your hardest problem.
claude.closer: Claude, the AI for people with real problems to solve. Bring it your hardest one. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
claude.look_prompt: She sits at the far side of a long meeting table in a corner office at dusk, small warm ceiling lamps glowing, city lights blurring through the windows behind her, soft even light on her face with gentle shadow, no harsh brightness. A closed notebook and a printed page rest on the table in front of her. She wears a soft charcoal blazer over an ivory blouse, hair down, minimal natural makeup, calm settled smile. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: A long boardroom table crowded with FORTY identical copies of the same man, all gesturing wildly at each other with pens and papers, coffee cups everywhere, total silent chaos of waving arms. Mouths closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: One by one the duplicate men fold flat like paper and slide down the table, stacking into a single clean white sheet that glides to a stop in front of the one remaining man, who sits calmly. One duplicate leaves behind a small paper crane. Mouths closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: The one remaining man picks up the single sheet in the now-empty sunlit boardroom, reads it, exhales, and leans back in his chair with quiet relief, the paper crane still on the table. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

claudecode.positioning: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files and runs commands, in the terminal, IDE and web (verified: claude.com/product/claude-code, code.claude.com docs, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
claudecode.quirk: the rubber duck on the desk slowly rotates to watch the vines work
claudecode.bed: playful mechanical groove with soft synth arps, instrumental
claudecode.narration: His code grew legs overnight and started finishing itself. Claude Code is the agent in your terminal that reads the codebase, fixes the bugs and ships the feature while you sip the coffee. Point it at the hard part.
claudecode.closer: Claude Code, the coding agent in your terminal. Point it at the hard part. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
claudecode.look_prompt: She sits centred behind a developer desk in a cosy dim study, facing the camera straight on, the desk edge crossing the foreground in front of her, lit by one soft warm lamp bounced off the wall, gentle even light on her face, no hard edge light, a code monitor glowing softly behind one shoulder, a small yellow rubber duck on a shelf. A closed laptop and a ceramic mug rest on the desk in front of her. She wears a dark hoodie open over a grey tee, hair loose, minimal natural makeup, easy quiet smile. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: A developer's home office at night where luminous green vines made of glowing text grow OUT of a laptop screen, branching across the desk and up the wall, blooming into small glowing app windows like flowers, while the developer leans back sipping coffee. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: The glowing text-vines weave themselves into neat braids across the room, windows blooming and arranging into a tidy wall of finished screens, while a small yellow rubber duck on the desk slowly rotates to watch them work. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: The vines retract gently back into the laptop, leaving the room ordinary except the wall of finished glowing screens, and the developer raises his mug to the laptop in a small toast. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
